title: The Lanterns on One Wire
youtube_title: The Lanterns on One Wire | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Finishing together matters more than finishing first.
summary: At a garden row with string and two watering cans, a wire of lanterns that sagged without a helper at the far hook will go wrong if one person rushes. Zola and Maude split it into two slow jobs, while Miss Dalca only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
